headline: Tesla now has more than 300 driverless taxis in Austin, including its new Cybercab, as safety advocates raise concerns.
score_reason: New fleet figures and live safety questions; the Cybercab launch itself was 3 Sep 2026.
importance_line: Austin residents now share roads with about 700 driverless cars from Tesla and Waymo, while safety advocates and federal regulators question the lack of national software standards.
summary: KEYE, the CBS station in Austin, reports that Tesla says it now runs more than 300 driverless taxis there, and a third-party Robotaxi Tracker counts 354, of which 178 are the steering-wheel-free Cybercab that launched on 3 Sep 2026. With Waymo's roughly 300 cars the city has about 700 autonomous vehicles, and a safety advocate cited a federal investigation into reports that some of the cars sped through school zones.
notes: School-zone investigation claim is as described by an advocate in the article; not independently confirmed.
